verdict.rationale: The only openness evidence is that Ramp's first-party CLI is described as open-source and hosted publicly at github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli. That lets a user read source for one official client component, but nothing indicates the core Ramp platform's source is available, and the specific license is never named. Missing for 10: source availability for the core Ramp product beyond the CLI client, an identified open license (e.g., MIT/Apache), and independent confirmation of the repository's licensing terms.
